title: fix(app-shell): a server error at an RLS clause's path holds the permission-set autosave
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 权限集编辑器里，RLS 的 USING/CHECK 子句若被服务端草稿裁决判为发布时会拒绝（如 USING 读公式字段），现在会像 CEL 语法错误一样挡住自动保存，并在字段上显示服务端原话。
- 为什么改：之前服务端裁决只用于显示、不计入保存门，作者看着报错却一直 200 保存，到 Publish 才 422。
- 风险与回滚：只改 app-shell 三个文件；裁决只在「字段文本等于裁决所评判的文本」时挡保存，改掉文本即放行（下一次保存的重读带来新裁决），避免死锁。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`CelPredicateField.tsx` 的 `report` 与 `heldKey` 效果；`draftVerdict.ts` 的 `serverHoldAt`；`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 里与 `servedVerdict` 同步设置的 `servedVerdictBody`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.serverVerdictHold-27482.test.tsx`，预期 4 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Part of #27482

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

This closes the RLS arm of the card. The Validations-tab arm is not done here and is listed under Acceptance notes, so the merge must not close the card.

## What changes

- `draftVerdict.ts`: a second context, `DraftVerdictBodyContext`, carries the body the served verdict judged. `valueAtPath` reads a dotted `_diagnostics` path in that body, and `serverHoldAt` / `useServerHoldAt` answer the served errors at a field's path only while the field shows the text that body holds there. No rule is restated: the server's errors are taken whole.
- `CelPredicateField.tsx`: a field with a `verdictPath` reports those held server errors through `onLintChange` as blocking errors, beside its lint findings. It re-reports when the hold starts, changes or lapses, keyed on the messages rather than on the array identity. Display is unchanged.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`: `servedVerdictBody` is set beside `servedVerdict` at each of its three reads (the load, the package door's post-save draft read, the environment door's post-save layered read) and provided to the RLS facets. The existing count, `celErrorCount`, now includes those errors, so the package door's autosave holds and the environment door's Save is disabled.

## Why

The draft read's `_diagnostics` reached the RLS clause's display (#26858) but never `celErrorCount`, so a predicate the publish refuses (a USING over a formula field, `rls-predicate-unenforceable`) kept autosaving with the server's message on screen. Triage asked for exactly this: a server error at the field's own path counts in `celErrorCount`, with no second client copy of the publish rule.

The verdict judges the stored draft and nothing else, and no door judges a text without storing it. Holding every edit while an error stands at the path would deadlock: the corrected clause could never be saved, so the next draft read could never clear it. So the hold applies while the clause still shows the judged text. Editing the clause away lets that one save go out, and its re-read brings the next verdict.

## Tests

- `PermissionMatrixEditor.serverVerdictHold-27482.test.tsx` (new, 4 cases, fake door decides the refusal): (a) a stored refused draft holds another edit, no PUT, message stays; (b) the card flow: the refused clause saves once, its re-read holds the next edit; (c) editing the clause away releases, the save goes out and its clean re-read clears the verdict; (d) typing back to the judged text before the autosave fires is held again, no PUT.
- `draftVerdict.test.ts`: four new cases for `valueAtPath` and `serverHoldAt` (judged text holds, other text does not, no body / no path / no error at that exact path holds nothing, an absent value reads as empty text).

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface widened, seat-approved:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/draftVerdict.ts`, the home of the served-verdict helpers. `PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx` is untouched: the held errors ride the existing `onLintChange` report.
- **Validations tab, not done (deviation):** its hold counter exists (`ObjectValidationsPanel`'s per-rule map, reported through `onBlockingIssuesChange` to the Data pillar's Save gate), but no server verdict reaches the Data pillar at all. `DataPillar` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` reads the object draft through `readDraftForSave(client, 'object', …)` and keeps only `extractDraftBody`, dropping `_diagnostics`; it provides no `DraftVerdictContext`, and `ConditionBuilder` passes no `verdictPath` to its `CelPredicateField`. Wiring it is: keep the object draft read's `_diagnostics` and body in `DataPillar` (load and post-save), provide both contexts, and give `ConditionBuilder` a `verdictPath` per rule. The hold then applies with no further change to the field. The server's path spelling for a validation rule's condition is not measured here. That region belongs to a sibling card in flight, so it is left to a follow-up.
- **The first save of a newly refused text still goes out.** Nothing on the client knows the refusal before the server stores and judges the text, and a client copy of the rule is ruled out. So in the card's step 5 the edit to another refused text saves once, and its re-read holds what follows.
- **Status line wording:** the held line reads the existing `perm.cel.saveBlocked` ("Fix the CEL syntax errors before saving."), which also covers this server-verdict hold; the field itself shows the server's message. Rewording it is left alone (the studio namespace is in a sibling card's diff).
- **Field-level `when` conditions** in the permission matrix pass no `verdictPath`, so they show and hold no server verdict, as before.
